The Subtask Name: Retrieval specialist skilled at web search, browsing and summarizing evidence
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: The Orchestrator repeatedly delegated the retrieval work to WebServing_Expert (steps 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14), specifying searches and scraping attempts tied to the goal.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeatedly issuing similar search directives without changing strategy can cause unproductive cycles.
      severity: 0.60
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the Orchestrator sets an unhelpful or redundant search direction, the WebServing_Expert pursues unproductive queries.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebServing_Expert continues similar searches, reinforcing a loop with low chance of finding new evidence.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Poorly scoped or incorrect tasking can send the retrieval down the wrong path.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the Orchestrator specifies the wrong episode or timing, the WebServing_Expert retrieves irrelevant data.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebServing_Expert’s efforts focus on incorrect sources, making later correction harder.

- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: WebServing_Expert reported search outcomes and site errors back to the Orchestrator (e.g., identifying the likely video at step 3, the 503 error at step 7, and lack of direct answers at steps 9, 11, 13, 15).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misinterpreting search snippets or page relevance can distort feedback.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: If results are misread or overstated, the Orchestrator receives inaccurate status or confidence.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Orchestrator may make misguided decisions, persisting with poor sources or abandoning good ones.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Reporting an inability to proceed without noting viable alternatives can prematurely halt progress.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the WebServing_Expert claims no path forward when options exist, the process may terminate early.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Orchestrator may conclude failure and not explore other agents or strategies.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Non-actionable feedback can cause the Orchestrator to keep re-issuing similar instructions.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: If feedback lacks concrete next steps, the Orchestrator might retry similar searches.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The cycle repeats with minimal progress.

- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: WebServing_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: loop_control
  agent_strength: 0.70
  agent_explanation: After each round of feedback, the Orchestrator initiated further search attempts with slight variations (steps 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14) and then suggested another expert round at step 19.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Driving repeated attempts without strategic change entrenches a loop.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the Orchestrator restarts the same approach, WebServing_Expert will likely reproduce the same failures.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebServing_Expert wastes cycles on similar queries yielding similar results.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Mis-summarizing prior feedback can skew the next instructions.
      severity: 0.50
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the Orchestrator misremembers what failed (e.g., the 503 cause), instructions may target the wrong fix.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebServing_Expert may focus on non-issues, missing effective alternatives.

- From_agent: WebServing_Expert
  To_agent: Orchestrator
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.80
  agent_explanation: The WebServing_Expert’s final assessment “Unable to determine” (step 15) directly led to the Orchestrator’s summary that the task was not completed (step 17).
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: A premature or incorrect “unable to determine” can end the process without exploring other avenues.
      severity: 0.85
      if_from_agent_wrong: If the WebServing_Expert gives up too early, the Orchestrator may finalize failure needlessly.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Orchestrator’s decision becomes anchored to an erroneous conclusion, blocking escalation to other agents.
